en_title: Rockstar North Chief Was Praying GTA 6's Big Story Reveal Stayed Under Wraps Ahead of Launch
cn_title: Rockstar North负责人曾祈祷《GTA 6》重大剧情揭秘在发售前不会泄露
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》序章揭示Lucia和Jason育有一名婴儿Tomás，这一情节直到游戏发售后才为玩家所知。Rockstar North联合负责人Rob Nelson表示，团队从未打算提前透露此事，并在发售前祈祷它不会泄露。

paragraphs.en: Warning! This article contains spoilers for the prologue of GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 警告！本文包含《GTA 6》序章的剧透。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6’s prologue hides a surprise that somehow managed to stay a secret all the way up to players finding out for themselves. And Rockstar North, it turns out, was praying for it not to leak ahead of launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》的序章藏着一个惊喜，不知怎么地，这个秘密一直保留到了玩家亲自发现它的时候。事实证明，Rockstar North一直在祈祷它不要在发售前泄露。

paragraphs.en: During the game’s opening stretch, the story of how Lucia ends up in a Leonida prison is told. This isn’t the surprising part — ever since GTA 6 Trailer 1 we’ve known she’d end up behind bars at some point — but the person she was at a diner moments before her arrest is. Tomás, a few-month-old baby and son of Lucia and Jason, is left behind by his mother in GTA 6’s first truly shocking reveal.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏开篇讲述了Lucia如何落入Leonida的一座监狱。这并不是令人惊讶的部分——自从《GTA 6》首支预告片发布以来，我们就知道她会在某个时候入狱——但她被捕前不久在一家餐馆里与她在一起的人却令人惊讶。Tomás是Lucia和Jason的儿子，还是个只有几个月大的婴儿，在《GTA 6》第一个真正令人震惊的揭秘中，他被母亲留了下来。

paragraphs.en: Given the history of leaks associated with GTA 6 , it feels like a minor miracle that Tommy’s existence remained a complete unknown until launch. This was something that Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North, was keenly aware of.
paragraphs.cn: 鉴于《GTA 6》过去曾遭遇过泄密，Tommy的存在直到发售时才为人所知，完全没有提前曝光，这感觉简直是一个小小的奇迹。Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson对此有着深刻的认识。

paragraphs.en: “No, we never were going to [reveal it]," he told VGC in an interview that took place just before GTA 6 came out last week. "I am still holding on. Fingers crossed, how many more days? I’m praying it stays under wraps. Given everything that we’ve gone through, every day I’m just like, ‘Please, please don’t do that, please don’t do that.'”
paragraphs.cn: 「不，我们从来没打算过［公开它］，」他在上周《GTA 6》发售前不久接受VGC采访时说道。「我还在坚持。祈祷好运，还剩多少天？我在祈祷它不会泄露。考虑到我们经历过的一切，我每天都在想：『拜托，拜托别这么做，拜托别这么做。』」

paragraphs.en: As we’ve written about at IGN, the existence of Tomás in GTA 6 is the key to its whole design . It’s what powers Jason and Lucia’s tale, and encourages the player to strive to make more and more money as those family savings goals get higher and higher. It connects us to the characters, and creates a shared objective between us and them. We aren’t simply committing crime for crime’s sake, but doing so with the prospect of being reunited with their son at the end of it.
paragraphs.cn: 正如我们此前在IGN所写的那样，Tomás在《GTA 6》中的存在是整套设计的关键。他推动着Jason和Lucia的故事发展，也在家庭储蓄目标越来越高的同时，激励玩家努力赚取越来越多的钱。他让我们与角色产生联系，并在我们和他们之间创造了一个共同目标。我们并不只是为了犯罪而犯罪，而是在犯罪的同时，期待最终能让他们与儿子团聚。

paragraphs.en: You can see why such a powerful and surprising narrative device would want to have been kept under wraps by Rockstar. It’s the first, and by no means the only, shocking revelation of GTA 6, all the more effective when witnessed firsthand.
paragraphs.cn: 你可以理解Rockstar为什么想让这样一个强有力且出人意料的叙事手法保密。这是《GTA 6》中第一个令人震惊的揭秘，但绝不是唯一一个；亲身体验时，它的效果更加强烈。

paragraphs.en: “We never were going to [reveal it],” Nelson explained. “It’s meant to shock. We were watching everyone speculate about the nature of their relationship and Jason’s character, and that takes it in a completely different context. You have something to strive for beyond a huge bank account at the end.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们从来没打算过［公开它］，」Nelson解释道。「它就是要让人震惊。我们看着大家猜测他们之间的关系以及Jason的性格，而这让一切有了完全不同的背景。除了最终拥有巨额银行存款之外，你还有了一个可以为之奋斗的目标。」
